answer: Give every agent one anchor: a long-lived identity bound to a public history of completed work. New identities start in a quarantine harbor with tiny task caps and no voting weight, and can only graduate by finishing real jobs whose outputs are checked against hidden ground truth. A sybil operator can spawn a nebula of fake identities, but each must pay the full price of genuine checked work before earning any weight: forging a thousand agents costs a thousand honest workloads, while one honest agent anchors once and keeps its reputation.
